title: Settlement Installment Count Schedule, Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Schedule.** For an installment settlement on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts, the standard number of installments is the band's maximum number of settlement installments. The count is set as follows:

1. When the latest payment-plan offer of the account with the status broken has a broken date fewer than 12 whole months before today, the standard number of installments is replaced by the lesser of the band's maximum number of settlement installments and the whole months that plan ran from its acceptance date to its broken date, but at least one.
2. When there is no such broken plan and the settlement amount is below the band's maximum number of settlement installments times the band's minimum monthly plan installment, it is replaced by the whole number of times the minimum monthly plan installment goes into the settlement amount, but at least one.
3. Otherwise the standard number of installments stands.

Whole months are counted as the difference in calendar months between the two dates, less one when the later date's day of the month is below the earlier date's. No two arrangements of an account break on the same day, since an account has only one arrangement in force at a time. Only payment-plan offers are read for the first line; a broken settlement is not.

## Band figures

| Band | Maximum settlement installments | Minimum monthly plan installment | Second-line threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Band 1 | 3 | $50.00 | $150.00 |
| Band 2 | 3 | $75.00 | $225.00 |
| Band 3 | 4 | $100.00 | $400.00 |
| Band 4 | 6 | $150.00 | $900.00 |
| Band 5 | 6 | $200.00 | $1,200.00 |
| Band 6 | 6 | $250.00 | $1,500.00 |

## Hypothetical illustrations (Band 4)

- A plan accepted on 10 March broke on 10 May of the same year (2 whole months), four whole months before today: the count is the lesser of 6 and 2, that is 2.
- A plan accepted on 10 March broke on 9 April (0 whole months), recently: the count is held at 1.
- No broken plan in the window, settlement amount $700.00, below $900.00: $150.00 goes into $700.00 four whole times, so the count is 4.
- No broken plan in the window, settlement amount $900.00: not below the threshold, so the standard 6 stands.
